sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件（数据截至 7 月 17 日 09:24 ET 盘前实时快照）：

  • Semiconductor/memory crash enters its second day, officially approaching bear-market territory: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index has fallen more than 8% this week, nearing a technical bear market. Premarket: SNDK 1367 (-15.2%), SOXL 126 (-23.8%), MRVL 182 (-11.7%), AMD 481 (-9.0%), INTC 93 (-9.7%), MU 825 (-8.7%, breaking below the 830 psychological level and already cut in half from last month’s high), TSM 395 (-5.9%, still sold off despite strong earnings), NVDA 201.8 (-5.0%, with the 200 level in danger). The trigger was a re-rating of the memory supply chain sparked by Samsung/SK Hynix results, with SK Hynix ADR down about 14% overnight.
  • Netflix Q3 guidance misses, plunges 10%: NFLX 65.89 (-10.6%). The company’s Q3 revenue guidance of $12.86 billion missed expectations, EPS of 0.82 was below the 0.84 consensus, and it announced a reduction in the frequency of viewership-data disclosures, igniting concerns that “engagement has peaked” and becoming the second fuse weighing on the Nasdaq.
  • China’s Kimi K3 open-source model shocks the AI narrative: Moonshot AI released on 7/16 a 2.8 trillion-parameter model, billed as the largest open-source model in history, with benchmarks approaching top U.S. systems. The market used this as an opportunity to question the AI CapEx moat of U.S. tech giants. GOOGL 345 (-7.0%) was hit hard premarket, amid community rumors that its new Gemini model has been delayed (unconfirmed by search).
  • Extreme divergence between indices and high beta: QQQ 692 (-3.57%) was hammered premarket, while SPY was only 744 (-1.40%), DIA 521 (-0.85%), and IWM 293 (-1.08%). AAPL 333 (+1.80%) was the only heavyweight bucking the market to trade green, while MSFT 394 (-0.45%) was relatively resilient and helped hold up the indices.
  • Oil rises for a fourth straight day; geopolitical tensions escalate: Brent recently surged to around $85, a one-month high, traffic through the Strait of Hormuz fell sharply, and Kuwait said power plants and desalination plants were attacked by Iran. XLE and USO were slightly higher premarket, making energy one of the few green sectors; gold weakened abnormally.

社区氛围：整体极度悲观，恐慌与麻木交织在一起。投降式的黑色幽默随处可见——屏幕上充满了损失色情内容，“请只一根绿色蜡烛”、“断路器”和“关掉应用程序，不要看”。与此同时，大量的反射性逢低买入和“这是历史性下跌”的痴迷持续存在，表明真正的投降尚未到来。

恐惧/贪婪：处于恐惧区域。 VIX 期货一再被称为“起飞”，但社区嘲笑自己“几乎没有脱离 ATH”——SPY 距历史高点仅约 2%，与高贝塔值 30-70% 的回撤形成鲜明对比。这表明恐慌高度集中在科技/半导体领域，而不是整个市场的系统性抛售。

情绪与现实：这是这次最重要的分歧。评论部分充斥着“世界末日/2000年3月重播/熔断”，但实际盘面显示SPY仅下跌-1.4%，道指下跌-0.85%，而等权重标普昨天甚至收于ATH。社区的绝望程度远超指数实际跌幅；从本质上讲，“杠杆科技多头的局部灾难”已被放大为“全面市场崩盘”。
